name: craftstory
description: Talking-avatar videos from a photo: CraftStory 2.0 (any length, lip-sync, gestures) and MiniMax H3 clips with generated sound, straight from Claude.
long_description: Turn a photo into a talking video from Claude. Pick a voice, write the script, and get a lip-synced video with natural gestures (CraftStory 2.0, any length, 8-15 minutes per video), or a short clip with generated sound (MiniMax H3, up to 15 s). Uses your CraftStory account and credits; a plan with API access and an API key from Account -> API Access are required.

prompts.name: talking_video_from_photo
prompts.description: Script + photo -> talking video, step by step
prompts.text: Make a talking video of the person in ${arguments.photo} saying: "${arguments.script}". Use list_voices to pick a voice, create_audio_clip for the speech, wait_for_job until the clip is done, preview_cost, then create_craftstory2_video and wait_for_job repeatedly until it reports done; finish with get_job_result and give me the video URL.

api_key.title: CraftStory API key
api_key.description: Create one in the CraftStory app: Account -> API Access (keys look like sk-cs-...). Requires a plan with API access.
